questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): An employee covered under CGHS cannot simultaneously claim medical reimbursement under the CS(MA) Rules. Reason (R): The two schemes are mutually exclusive, and an employee is governed by CGHS if their residence falls within a CGHS notified area.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of. A Participation in government health provisions is mutually exclusive based on geographic location. An employee residing within a notified scheme zone is compulsorily covered by that scheme and cannot simultaneously seek reimbursement under medical attendance rules, ensuring clear administrative distinction between the two distinct health frameworks.

key_facts: Answer key: (A)

questions.question_english: What is the concept of a “CGHS Empanelled Hospital”?
options_english: A private hospital contracted with the Government to treat beneficiaries at CGHS rates
A government-owned medical hospital exclusively reserved for Central Government servants
A military hospital converted into a civilian medical clinic for government employees
Any accredited hospital located within a five-kilometer radius of a CGHS Wellness Centre
questions.explanation_english: A private hospital contracted with the Government to treat beneficiaries at CGHS rates. An empanelled hospital is a private healthcare institution that enters into a formal agreement or memorandum of understanding with the government. Under this agreement, the hospital undertakes to treat authorized scheme beneficiaries for specified diagnostic tests, inpatient procedures, and surgeries at standardized, pre-approved government package rates.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है: सरकार के साथ अनुबंध वाला निजी अस्पताल, जो CGHS दरों पर लाभार्थियों का उपचार करता है। स्रोत में दिए गए स्पष्टीकरण के अनुसार यही नियम, पात्रता-शर्त या प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया इस प्रश्न पर लागू होती है।
